description: Court-registrar reporting shows January sit-ins/strike activity, but relative-date wording, the Jan 3 “third day” description, and a separate Dec 30 one-day sit-in do not establish onset or uninterrupted continuity. Cross-site national coordination versus distinct local actions is also unresolved. No continuation is coded because continuity from December is not proven.
required_followup: Seek dated local reports from each court/council, especially Constantine and Sidi M’hamed, and verify whether any physical action continued without interruption across 30 Dec–3 Jan.

description: No opened January source gives a numeric headcount for the court sit-ins or the taxi sit-in. Qualitative “large/crowded” wording at Tizi Ouzou and occupational-workforce/strike percentages do not establish 50 people gathered.
required_followup: Find event-specific turnout estimates from local correspondents or other contemporaneous reporting; do not convert workers, routes, or strike participation percentages to attendees.

description: The physical end is unreported for the court strike/sit-ins and taxi sit-in. The Feb 2 taxi gathering addresses the same route dispute but does not establish continuous action from Jan 23; the Dec 30 court sit-in likewise does not establish continuity into January.
required_followup: Search dated follow-up reporting for actual termination or intervening absences; keep separately dated gatherings separate unless uninterrupted presence is documented.

description: The January tax strikes, taxi/bakers work stoppages, and national lawyer court boycott have direct state-facing or occupational demands, but opened sources document stoppage/boycott rather than a qualifying public gathering. Contract teachers’ 16 January action is an announcement only; planned sit-ins were not verified.
required_followup: Look for contemporaneous reports of actual gatherings and turnout at tax offices, education directorates, taxi routes, bakeries, or courts; keep stoppages and court boycotts separate from documented public gatherings.

description: El Watan’s 19 January tax-strike story remains search-only after a web-tool 502 and ordinary HTTPS DNS failure. Neither is an observed publisher denial. Ennahar/Echorouk/Sarih and local reporting add evidence, but do not replace the inaccessible article body.
required_followup: If ordinary retrieval later succeeds and the access ledger still allows manual review, open the exact El Watan article; otherwise retain search-only status without treating the technical failures as a publisher restriction.

description: Searches cover general and weekly French/English/Arabic queries plus targeted labor sectors and regional queries; Q018 included a Taqbaylit phrase but yielded no verifiable January Tamazight source. Coverage remains open-web only, with no LexisNexis search; the retrospective Open Data Tank page’s linked dataset/codebook were not retrieved.
required_followup: Continue local and Arabic/French/Tamazight regional searches and consult available LexisNexis or the official baseline gate when authorized; do not infer no events from search silence.

description: Most event-specific state-response and protester-violence dimensions are not reported. At Sidi M’hamed, officials spoke with registrars and said requests were under consideration; no concrete accommodation is established. Taxi-driver altercations are reported separately from the sit-in.
required_followup: Check follow-up accounts for event-specific arrests, beatings, dispersal, killings, shootings, accommodation, or explicit nonresponse; retain unknown when no evidence is available.
